extracted.intended_audience: prospective Carpentries Instructor Trainers (Carpentries instructors considering the trainer role)
extracted.subtask_description: Steps, requirements, and curriculum for becoming a certified Instructor Trainer for The Carpentries, including application/acceptance, a 10-week training, post-training certification exercises, and accessibility guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instructor Trainer role/responsibilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Instructor Trainers teach The Carpentries Instructor Training Events. They train new Instructors in the basics of educational psychology and evidence-based teaching practices. They also support and play a leadership role in the oversight of the Instructor Training program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Trainers are expected to lead Instructor Training events, support onboarding of new instructors, and take leadership in program oversight and development.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instructor Trainer Training process
rubrics_metrics.description: Instructor Trainer Training is the process by which we onboard new Instructor Trainers. The training consists of 10 weekly 1-hour sessions, where we will discuss The Carpentries’ teaching philosophy and review supporting materials summarising the research that underpins our Instructor Training curriculum.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Training is structured as ten 1-hour weekly sessions that cover Carpentries teaching philosophy and the research basis for the Instructor Training curriculum.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete 10-week training (attendance requirement)
rubrics_metrics.description: Attend 10 weekly 1-hour sessions where you’ll learn the basics of educational psychology and evidence-based teaching practices, and how to teach this information to others.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Successful candidates must participate in the full sequence of ten weekly sessions to learn both the content and how to teach it to new instructors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application & acceptance requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications for Instructor Trainer Training open 1-2 times per year. You will need to submit an application and be accepted into the program to attend training.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The program is highly competitive with a limited number of applicants accepted each intake; plan to apply when calls open (1–2 times annually).

rubrics_metrics.name: Post-training certification steps (exercises)
rubrics_metrics.description: Following the 10-week training, trainees are asked to complete a number of exercises to become certified Carpentries Instructor Trainers, including shadowing an Instructor Training Event and a Teaching Demonstration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Certification is not automatic after attendance; trainees must complete follow-on practical exercises (e.g., shadowing and delivering a teaching demonstration) as part of the certification process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Curriculum topic: How Learning Works (research-based principles)
rubrics_metrics.description: How Learning Works: Seven Research-Based Principles for Teaching.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This topic covers core research-supported principles that underpin effective teaching and the Instructor Training curriculum.

rubrics_metrics.name: Curriculum topic: Creating inclusive and accessible learning spaces
rubrics_metrics.description: Creating inclusive and accessible learning spaces.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Trainees will learn practices for designing and facilitating workshops that are accessible and inclusive to diverse learners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Curriculum topic: Preparing for and teaching Instructor Training
rubrics_metrics.description: Preparing for and teaching Instructor Training.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focuses on how to prepare for leading Instructor Training sessions and how to teach the Instructor Training curriculum to instructor candidates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Curriculum topic: Hosting teaching demonstrations
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers expectations and practices for running and assessing teaching demonstrations, a component of certification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Curriculum topic: Onboarding to the Instructor Trainer community
rubrics_metrics.description: Onboarding to the Instructor Trainer community.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers community norms, roles, and how new trainers integrate into the global Instructor Trainer community.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accessibility and accommodation request process
rubrics_metrics.description: The Carpentries is committed to providing inclusive and accessible content that enables all individuals, including those with disabilities, to participate and engage fully. To request accessibility support for a Carpentries event, please visit our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Statement and fill out the accessibility support request form provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Trainees who need accommodations should follow the DEI statement link and submit the accessibility support request form; the program explicitly supports accessibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact & inquiries
rubrics_metrics.description: Have Questions? Please contact our team at instructor.training@carpentries.org.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the provided email for questions about the application, training schedule, certification steps, or accommodations.
